title: Mixed Event — The Warmth of Intersecting Melodies — Episode5 I Want to Know

meta.Event Outline: Ichika has her eye on the last copy of a CD by an artist who creates Miku songs, but so does a fellow shopper—a girl with long hair. Surprisingly, the girl allows Ichika to take it. Putting the pieces together, Mafuyu realizes the girl in question was Kanade...

rows.Line: Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Excuse me, Ms. Yoisaki.
Thank you for having me today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll start cleaning and make enough food to last you a few days. Is there anything you'd like to eat tonight?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Tonight...?
Not particularly.
I'll leave it up to you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay.
It's starting to get chilly, so why don't I make you something that's nice and warm.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, it has been getting chilly.
It was so cold the other day when I went out to run an errand.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That's very common during a transitional period, so please try to keep warm and stay healthy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
You too, Ms. Mochizuki.
Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I will. Anyway, I'll start cleaning...
Kanade's Room

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, it's just...
I think my friend has this exact same CD.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
Then, your friend must like this artist too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also, this isn't actually my CD.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, it isn't?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No. I went to the CD shop the other day to buy a copy, but there was only one left. This other person seemed to really want it, so I let them have it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Luckily, a friend of mine just happened to know this person, so I was able to borrow it from them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Excuse me if I'm wrong, but does this friend of yours happened to be named Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, how did you know...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A few days ago, my friend was talking about handing over her CD to Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She even mentioned how this was the last copy and the way this other person let her have it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: My friend even showed me some of the videos that this person made and the music just sounded so similar to what you usually play, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
Thank you for listening to our music.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, before I forget...
Would you mind returning this CD to your friend for me?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I know I should be asking Mafuyu to do this instead of you, Ms. Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I found something that probably means quite a bit to your friend with it, so I'd like to get it back to them as soon as possible...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Something that means a lot to her...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, I understand.
I'll take it back to her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you. I appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also, I was surprised to hear from Mafuyu that she knew the person I ran into, but to think that you were her friend too...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm just as surprised...!
I never knew that you were friends with Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Friends...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
And well...
I'm glad it turned out to be you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Knowing that makes me happy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It does...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry.
It's just so interesting how my friend ended up meeting you in such a way.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, this artist isn't that well known, so I was surprised to meet another one of their fans too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'm also glad to have had that encounter.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, Ms. Yoisaki...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Would you like to meet my friend...? That is, if you'd like to...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: M-Me meeting her?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. She also mentioned how she was hoping to talk more with you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She seems to want to get to know you better as both a fellow songwriter and a fan of Miku songs.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I've never actually made that much of an emotional investment into Miku songs but...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Again, you don't have to if don't like...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay.
I'd like to thank her for the CD, so would you mind setting us up?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. I'm yet to meet anyone outside of my group who makes their own songs, so I'd like to take this opportunity to talk with your friend.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, thank you so much...!
Hehe. She'll be so happy to hear this!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, there's actually one more thing that I'd like to ask you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Would you mind joining us for this? I honestly don't really get out much, so I may have some trouble keeping a conversation going.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'd be happy to.
I'll be sure to work it into my schedule.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you very much.
bgm_area00005
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Is everything okay, Mafuyu?
Is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Maybe. I'm not sure...
Something has been on my mind.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Care to explain?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Well, it's about the CD I helped Kanade get...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I couldn't be happier since I'd given up on being able to listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
Good for you, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That time... The way she smiled made my chest feel so warm for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Before she'd even listened to it too. Why is that...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu, I knew I'd find you here.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Kanade...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, there's something I need to report to you. Also, Miku mentioned before how she wanted to listen to this CD.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Report...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So you get to meet the girl who lent you this CD...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. As it turns out, she's a friend of Ms. Mochizuki from the housekeeping service I use.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I believe it'll also be a good learning experience since I hardly ever get to meet other people who make their own music like this...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, and I was wondering if you'd like to join us, Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Why...?
You don't need me to be there, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see Hoshino at school on a regular basis, so I don't see any point in me going.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was just wondering if you'd be interested since she's also trying to create her own music.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Not only that, you're the one who sort of brought us together, so it'd be nice to have you there with me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: All I did was bring her CD to you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are you sure you don't want to go, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You seemed to be mulling over something just now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Could it be that you were wondering if going with Kanade will help you find some answers?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Maybe...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Is something bothering you, Mafuyu?
Is everything okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, there's nothing to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(But what if Miku's right...?
If going with Kanade means discovering something...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, I'll go...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Would you mind telling me when you'll be meeting them once you know more?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, of course...!
I'll be sure to let you know.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You're welcome...
